answer: Island-quarantine forge: a new identity is forged only inside an isolated island sandbox, where the applicant must complete a live, unscripted service task cut off from outside tools. Each puppet costs $60 in seat and examiner fees, so 1,000 puppets cost $60,000 with no bulk discount; an honest user pays $60 once.
